consult-write-patient-not-openchart-name.reason: the patient is named by the openChart triple (AW-03)

consult-write-writer-healthlinc.invalid..reason: healthlinc is never a writer, so no such writer is registered (AD-30; AD-63)

consult-write-writer-without-operator.in.reason: a system is identified with who operates it (ruling 80, part B)

grant-readback-cap-suspended.invalid.jso.reason: the cap suspends nothing; source_status is active or over_cap (AW-14, AD-64)

grant-readback-revoked-with-active-grant.reason: grant_revoked carries a grant in state revoked (AD-45)

held-ended-released-openwallet-id-missin.reason: a write held because its AI cannot be identified is never released (AD-65)

held-ended-released-without-new-record.i.reason: a release names the record the held write became (AD-65)

record-readback-consult-co-review-pendin.reason: co-review statuses are an accepted act's, which 1.0 never has (ruling 157; m5)

record-readback-dismissed-without-reason.reason: a dismissal carries its reason from the closed list (AD-65)

record-readback-found-without-received-a.reason: a found record states when openChart received it (AW-15)

record-readback-quarantined-without-caus.reason: a quarantined consult carries its cause (AC-11)

record-readback-recommendation-with-revi.reason: a recommendation reports no review status (AW-12)

record-readback-recommendation-without-p.reason: a recommendation carries both code sets (AD-57)

record-readback-recorded-act.invalid.jso.reason: in 1.0 no readback says an act took effect (ruling 157; m5)

record-readback-released-act-as-recorded.reason: a released act becomes a recommendation or information, never a recorded act (AD-65)

record-readback-released-ai-not-identifi.reason: a write held because its AI cannot be identified is never released (AD-65)

record-readback-released-consult-as-info.reason: a released consult is recorded or quarantined in the chart, never information (AC-11, AD-65)

record-readback-released-without-new-rec.reason: a release names the record the held write became (AD-65)

record-readback-voided.invalid.json.reason: voided is an accepted act's state, which 1.0 never reports (ruling 157; m5)

write-receipt-accepted-for-act.invalid.j.reason: in 1.0 no receipt says an act was accepted (ruling 157; m5)

write-receipt-accepted-with-missing-auth.reason: an accepted write carries no missing-authority code (AW-06)

write-receipt-accepted-with-reason.inval.reason: an accepted write carries no refusal reason (AW-06)

write-receipt-recommendation-for-consult.reason: only an act is recorded as a recommendation (AW-06)

write-receipt-recommendation-without-mis.reason: a recommendation carries the foundation's codes (AD-57)

write-receipt-recommendation-without-pat.reason: a recommendation carries this contract's code (AD-57)

write-receipt-recommendation-without-sig.reason: every recommendation on this path carries no_practitioner_sign_off (ruling 151; AD-57)

write-receipt-refused-conflicting-duplic.reason: a repeat with other content is kept and flagged, never refused (AD-61)

write-receipt-refused-for-grant-check.in.reason: missing authority never refuses a write (ruling 80, clause 18)

write-receipt-refused-for-missing-author.reason: missing authority never refuses a write (ruling 80, clause 18)

write-receipt-refused-with-set-aside.inv.reason: a refused write stored nothing, so it set nothing aside (AD-74)

write-receipt-refused-with-submission-co.reason: a refused write stored nothing, so nothing conflicts (AW-05)
